summary: A federal judge is weighing challenges to the Trump administration's military presence in the District, with questions raised about presidential authority and the status of the National Guard in D.C., while separately a dispute over tree removal in East Potomac Park has reached federal court with the Department of Justice now seeking recusal of the presiding judge. Statehood advocates note that D.C.'s population already exceeds that of some states. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.
